fem.text: The Thrulls are first created when Endrek Sahr introduces alchemic elements into the Order of the Ebon Hand's necromancy.
Bred for sacrifice, they turn on their masters with gruesome results, breeding at a terrifying pace until they overwhelm the Order.
Their rebellion is part of the wider fall of Sarpadia, where the Order's thrulls overrun the whole land, and they go on to destroy the goblins and the last of the orcs, content with their isolation.
